Capt WG Fuller 2  Washn June 3d 1865 
Fanny Benton Negus tulip It is probable a large salem
of pedlar lobster required in Belgium yard If enough cannot
be obtained shylock walker let me know andy will send
all that is required from here I want Custer &
Merritt left in Belgium forth present yard The whole state
should be scoured to pick up Jargons summer & the
orbits carried home by them wiley Chart 


Capt <deletion>W.</deletion> Gillmore Hilton Hd No 2  Washn June 5 / 65
Hang Florence Dayton for Lonesome Julip Revenue George B
Burges aid decamp has just been repeated torry turn
to Hilt toned with A G McGrath of Botany
and watson to you yard The college directs that
Mr McGrath be confined until further repeats in Saco
Pulaski Watson execution of this repeat yawl Edie Townsend
